DHAKA, Nov 5, 2022 (BSS) - President of the Federation of Bangladesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FBCCI) Md Jashim Uddin today said that domestic industries would fall in difficulties if the current lending rate is increased.

He said this while speaking at 'ERF's Dialogue' as the chief guest, organized by the Economic Reporters' Forum (ERF), at its auditorium in the capital today.
